sam: Heads-up: scheduling a staggered GPU driver + kernel patch roll across dedicated inference pools in us-east-1 next Thu 01:30 UTC. Window per-pool ~15m, total maintenance 1.5h. Goal: validate live-rolling upgrades, workload reclaim, and SLO tagging for driver-level upgrades.

nina: Added. Which pools are in scope and what's the risk model?

sam: In-scope: dedicated-pool-a, dedicated-pool-b, dedicated-pool-c (one at a time). Risk: short-lived pod restarts and potential KV cache warmup tails. No expected control-plane write loss.

oliver: We'll need explicit rollback and pause points between pools. Also ask to mute noisy 5xx alerts for each pool window.

sre-bot: maintenance created: maint-1791509876 | start: 2026-09-02T01:30:00Z | est_duration: 90m | owner: sam

kat: Loadgen: we'll simulate client patterns: ramp 0->200 TPS for pool under upgrade, hold 10m, then allow recovery. Mix 75% text-gen, 15% streaming chat, 10% embeddings. Tag runs with drv-roll/1791509876.

sam: Abort criteria (per-pool):
- 5m error rate for pool > 2.0%
- p95 latency delta > 500ms above baseline for >5m
- KV cache warmup > 5m tail with steady errors >0.5%
If abort at any pool -> stop rollout and rollback that pool.

nina: Please paste exact alert queries so we don't mismatch.

sam: Copied (promql):
```
# pool 5xx ratio > 2%
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference\",pool=~\"dedicated-pool-.*\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (pool) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference\",pool=~\"dedicated-pool-.*\"}[5m])) by (pool) > 0.02
# p95 per-pool
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"inference\",pool=~\"dedicated-pool-.*\"}[5m])) by (le,pool)) > (pool_baseline_p95 + 0.5)
```

ben: Prechecks: I'll run `scripts/driver_preflight.sh us-east-1 --pools=dedicated-pool-a,dedicated-pool-b,dedicated-pool-c` and post results. It validates driver compatibility, node-drain readiness, and kv-replica health.

oliver: Mute plan: scope mute to `inference.pool.*.5xx.alert` and `kv.cache.warmup` for each pool window; keep paging for control-plane write failures. We'll also add a short message to the SLO dashboard noting this is planned.

ops-comm: I'll prepare a status page banner (internal-facing) and send PMs to customers using dedicated pools. We'll mark this as maintenance with `maintenance:driver_roll_us_east1`.

sam: Operator run steps (condensed):
1) preflight: `rjctl driver-check --region=us-east-1 --pools=...`
2) patch pool A: `rjctl pool-patch --pool=dedicated-pool-a --image=driver-v2.3 --kernel=5.18.12 --pause-after=10m`
3) observe metrics + alerts for 10m, if green -> continue to next pool. If abort -> `rjctl pool-rollback --pool=dedicated-pool-a`
4) repeat for pools B and C

nina: Who's primary during the window?

oliver: I'll be primary oncall for first half, nina for second half. Sam is rollout owner. Ben owns prechecks. Ops-comm owns customer comms.

ben: Preflight green for pool-a and pool-b, pool-c has one node with slightly high mirror-lag (90s) — I'll re-run health checks tonight and remediate before the window. Posting output to the thread.

kat: I'll ensure loadgen tags include `maintenance:driver_roll_us_east1` and produce per-pool trace bundles for post-mortem.

ops-comm: Banner draft: "Planned maintenance: driver patching in us-east-1. Short restarts possible for dedicated-pool customers. Contact SRE if you see unexpected behavior."

sam: Note for SLO accounting: tag metrics with `maintenance:driver_roll_us_east1` and include in postmortem. We'll do a 2hr post-check after last pool finishes.

oliver: One more ask: add a temporary sampling rule to keep 100% of error traces for 30m after each pool patch so we can inspect failures.

sre-bot: reminder in 24h: maint-1791509876 starts in 24h

nina: Updated runbook with pause points and rollback commands. I'll post the final preflight pass tomorrow morning.

ben: Preflight re-run tonight targeted pool-c fixes. Will report back.

sam: Thanks all. If preflight flags anything, postpone. Otherwise we proceed. :white_check_mark:
